title: A payer picked in New Customer is saved with the window's Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Customer.
  2. Fill in the fields New Customer needs with a new name for this test.
  3. In "Bill Invoices To", pick customer B.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open the new customer's Edit Customer window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • The fields are filled.

Step 3:

  • The field shows customer B's name.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the new customer is created.
  • The new customer's left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer B's name.

Step 5:

  • "Bill Invoices To" shows customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R5: “The pick saves together with the window's Save; if any part fails, nothing is saved and no customer is created.”
  • S1-R1: “When a default other than the customer itself is saved, the customer page left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with the payer's name.”
  • Key Decisions: “A saved default Bill To, one hop, applied at creation only. Set in New Customer and Edit Customer; applied silently when a work order or part sale is created and shown on its Customer card.”
